description: Islas de Calor Urbanas is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Montevideo. Este juego de datos contiene 3 archivos ráster obtenidos de la aplicación URSA (Urban Reporting based on Satellite Analysis) desarrollada por el Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo (BID) con información sobre Islas de Calor Urbanas procesada en base a imágenes satelitales del año 2022. Coverage: Intendencia de Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Montevideo. Its tags are Ambiente, Harvest, Islas de Calor Urbanas, Ordenamiento territorial. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-07-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
